calibration.method: Both controls submitted to zerogpt.com in the same session as the post, each in its own fresh browser context, after an identity probe confirmed the page echoed the submitted text back at an equal character count.

humanControl.source: data/guides.tsx - the founder's own published prose, written before this pipeline existed

calibration.verdict: NOT DISCRIMINATING. 17.8 points separate the founder's own writing from pure machine output, and the founder's side is labelled 'AI/GPT Generated'. Any absolute floor is therefore unachievable by writing, and a reading near it is instrument noise rather than a property of the prose.
calibration.supersedes: The pre-2026-11-10 rationale, which read: 'Measured calibration: the founder's own prose scores 0 and genuinely corporate prose scores 100, so the detector discriminates. A delta gate rewards real improvement without making an absolute floor the pipeline's only objective.' That premise was measured FALSE on 2026-11-09. It is recorded here rather than deleted, because it was cited as evidence for the floor it justified.
calibration.recheck: Re-run both controls before trusting any absolute reading. If separation exceeds 60 points again, an absolute floor may be reinstated - with the measurement recorded here, not asserted in prose.

notes: No absolute floor. requireFinalBelow was removed on 2026-11-10: it was calibrated on a premise the controls now contradict.
The delta still applies: a post starting at or above requireReductionFrom must fall by minAbsoluteReduction. A post starting below it has nothing to prove and passes.

onControlFailure 'report-and-proceed': when the controls show the detector is not discriminating, record AI-DETECTION: UNVERIFIED with both control scores and CONTINUE. Holding on an instrument that fails its own control blocks the pipeline without evidence about the writing.

scoreSelector.note: Read the number bound to the verdict text. 98.4% and <1% are ZeroGPT's own marketing copy and appear identically on every result.

preconditions: chromium binary present - it lives in a purgeable cache on a volume that has repeatedly hit 100%; reinstall before the probe, never assume
control-human.txt and control-machine.txt both present in this directory - without them no reading can be interpreted
